description: GitHub issue #30 comment 5384356411: left collapsible panel with page thumbnails (Okular-style page picker for multi-page PDFs); centre pane holds the PDF at ~65% width; right panel shows raw text preview, CSV tables, and annotations for the CURRENTLY DISPLAYED page, read live from the project's markdown file (per op-7amv's persistence child). Depends on the markdown-persistence child for real content to show; can ship the layout + thumbnail strip first with an empty/placeholder right panel.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
Implemented. crates/kovan/src/digitiser/gui/desktop/pdf_reader.rs:
- Left page-thumbnail strip (`thumbnail_strip`/`thumbnail_texture`): low-DPI (36, vs the main viewer's 150) rasterization, cached per page index, only for the pages actually scrolled into view (`egui::ScrollArea::show_rows`, not eager for the whole document). Only shown for a multi-page PDF; a "Show/Hide pages" toolbar toggle collapses it (Okular-style). Clicking a thumbnail jumps to that page.
- Right "page context" panel (`context_panel`): reads the project's markdown file live off disk (no caching -- matches the issue's "live from markdown file" wording) and filters `### ...` subsections down to the ones tagged with the currently displayed page (`page: N`/`page N,`, the exact provenance text op-96am's save actions already emit) via a new free function `blocks_matching` -- a plain substring filter over `###`-delimited blocks, not a markdown parser, since the marker text is under this crate's own control. 4 new unit tests.
- Both panels are `egui::Panel::left`/`::right` `.show_inside`, resizable, with the centre (unchanged canvas/ScrollArea code) getting whatever's left -- not pixel-exact 65%, but the issue's own "~65%" wording and a user-resizable side panel achieve the same effect without hardcoding a width that would fight a user's own window size.

cargo check --all-targets clean (native + aarch64-linux-android, after fixing 2 deprecated-API warnings the first pass introduced -- egui::SidePanel -> egui::Panel::left/right, default_width -> default_size). cargo test --release: 187 kovan lib tests passing. Not committed yet.

title: kovan-gui: PDF reader 3-pane layout -- page-thumbnail strip, PDF at ~65% width, live right panel from markdown

description:
Child of op-mmep. New file crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/src/components/distillation_column.rs.

No generic column/tray/vessel widget exists in components/ today (verified 2026-08-15 -- directory listing is entirely reactor/steam-plant-specific: heat_exchanger, condenser, pump, valve, pipe/bend, reactor_vessel variants, turbine, cooling_tower, plus reactor-only pebble_bed_texture/control_rod_drive/reactor_archetype/excursion). condenser.rs (CondenserVisual) is directly reusable for the column's overhead condenser; heat_exchanger.rs can stand in for the reboiler. Only the column shell + tray stack itself needs a new widget.

Follow the crate's stated convention (CLAUDE.md): one file, composes its physics counterpart (DynamicColumnProfiles from dwsim-libs) plus visual-only fields, egui::Widget impl, enum dispatch not trait objects. Colour each tray by its stage temperature using the crate's existing color_maps (do not invent a new color scale). Take per-stage T/x/y as plain scalars/slices at construction (mirrors PipeVisual::from_scalars's pattern per the crate CLAUDE.md note that scalar-backed widgets are not placeholders) so the widget has no dependency on dwsim-libs types directly if that's cleaner, or accepts &DynamicColumnProfiles directly -- implementer's call, document which.

Depends on nothing else in this epic; can be built in parallel with the physics layer.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
DONE 2026-08-15. crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/src/components/distillation_column.rs -- DistillationColumnVisual, scalar-backed per the crate's PipeVisual::from_scalars precedent (no long-lived physics counterpart object exists for a per-step-computed DynamicColumnProfiles). Draws condenser cap, N trays coloured by hot_to_cold_colour_mark_1 normalised across the column's own min/max stage temperature, reboiler sump. Registered in components/mod.rs.

Gates: cargo build --release -p outram-park-digital-twin-engine --lib clean; cargo check -p outram-park-digital-twin-engine --target aarch64-linux-android clean (whole components/ module is already Android-gated at lib.rs, confirmed the widget does not break that).

title: distillation_sim_v1: new engine widget -- components::distillation_column tray-stack visual
